title: Moogle knowledge release manifest
description: Describes one versioned, distributable release of the processed BG-Wiki Markdown knowledge corpus.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version, bumped on breaking field changes.

moogle_version.description: Moogle application/software version this corpus was packaged with, e.g. 1.0.0.

knowledge_version.description: Knowledge corpus version, independent of moogle_version, e.g. bgwiki-20250225.1.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp the archive/manifest were generated.

retrieved_date.description: Date the dump was retrieved from BG-Wiki, e.g. 2025-02-25.

checksum.description: sha256 of the raw (pre-decompression) dump, if known.

document_count.description: Number of markdown files included in the archive after downselection.

name.description: Embedding model this corpus is expected to be embedded with, e.g. mxbai-embed-large.

anythingllm.description: AnythingLLM image tag this corpus/manifest was tested against.

ollama.description: Ollama image tag this corpus/manifest was tested against.

sha256.description: sha256 checksum of the archive file.
